translator_notes: Traditional love song, origin unclear. Line 3-4 is my reading: 'ако ми е с' мојто прво либе' is ambiguous (possibly 'if she is not my first love').

lines.cyr: Цутела е ружа в' градина ле,
lines.lat: Cutela e ruža v' gradina le,
lines.en: A rose has bloomed in the garden, oh,
above the rose a nightingale sings sweetly.

lines.cyr: - Проклет да е кој се с' мома љуби ле,
lines.lat: - Proklet da e koj se s' moma ljubi le,
lines.en: - Cursed be whoever courts a girl, oh,

lines.cyr: ако ми е с' мојто прво либе.
lines.lat: ako mi e s' mojto prvo libe.
lines.en: if she is not with my first love.
I courted her in the first year, oh,

lines.cyr: кажаа ми дека е уште мала.
lines.lat: kažaa mi deka e ušte mala.
lines.en: they told me she was still little.
I courted her in the second year, oh,
they told me she had no trousseau.
I courted her in the third year, oh,
they told me she had already married.
